<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 182.0732, which corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral exact mass of approximately 181.0659 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass within a few ppm, considering C, H, O, and N atoms, is C₉H₁₁NO₃ (exact mass = 181.0739 Da, error ≈ 44 ppm). This is the most plausible molecular formula for the compound in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>C9H11NO3</final_answer>
